newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said French President Jacques Chirac would visit the Commission on July 17 and would hold a joint news conference with Commission President Jacques Santer after lunchtime.
Van der Pas said Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin would visit the Commission on July 18 and would hold a news conference around 1230/1030 GMT.
Van der Pas also announced that Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima would visit Commission members on July 23.
He said agendas and news conference times for these meetings would be confirmed later this week.
Van der Pas said Commissioner Mario Monti had expressed, in a speech, the Commission's worries about recent violence in France surrounding cargoes of farm produce from Spain.
Spokesman Peter Guilford said the main purpose of Wednesday's EU/U.S. meeting on electronic commerce's was mutual information on both parties' recent proposals in this matter.
Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi said the Commission did not consider imposing more taxes on electronic commerce than on other kinds of commercial exchanges.
In answer to a question spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said the EU/Mexico agreement was still under negotiation.

- IP/97/617: EU Commissioner Gradin to visit Romania Seminar on control of European Union funds.
- IP/97/618: Commission launches pilot programme to assist fishermen in small-scale coastal fishing and women of fishing families.
- IP/97/619: Bulgaria: Commission approves emergency medical aid worth Ecu 700,000.
- IP/97/620: EU and U.S. meet to discuss Internet.
- Speech/97/154: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at business breakfast organised by Chester, Ellesmere Port and North Wales Chamber of Commerce.
- Speech/97/155: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at 7th international symposium organised by the Walled Towns Friendship Circle.
- Speech/97/156: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on the follow-up to the cohesion report from the point of view of the CAP and the rural development policy.
- Speech/97/157: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti on electronic commerce in Europe - creating a favourable environment for electronic commerce.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-23: Quaterly national accounts.
- Eurostat - Basic statistics of the European Union - 33rd edition / 1996.
- Provisional agenda for the Commission meeting on July 9, 1997.
- Speech by Begian Minister for Public Services Andre Flahaut at July 8, 1997 news conference.
